## Kriging for soil pH across ontario districts

```{r}
variogram = variogram(value_avg~1, soil_ontario) 
```

```{r, echo = FALSE, fig.cap = "Variogram of soil measurements(phH values) in Indiana. The number beside the points indicates the number of points from the variogram cloud that were in that particular bin."}
variogram |>
  plot(plot.numbers =TRUE,
       ylab =expression(gamma(h)),
       xlab = "Distance (h) in metres",
       pch =16)
```

```{r}
# different variogram models 
variogram_spherical  = fit.variogram(variogram, vgm(1, "Sph", 50000, 1))
variogram_gaussian = fit.variogram(variogram, vgm(1, "Gau", 40000, 1))
variogram_exponential = fit.variogram(variogram, vgm(1, "Exp", 50000, 1))
```

```{r, echo = FALSE, fig.cap = "Visualizing different variogram models"}
#plot the various models
plot(gamma~dist, variogram,
     ylab =expression(gamma(h)),
     xlab = "Distance (h) in metres",
     pch =16)
lines(variogramLine(variogram_exponential, 1.075 * max(variogram$dist)), 
      lty = 1, col = 'purple', lwd = 2)
lines(variogramLine(variogram_spherical, 1.075 * max(variogram$dist)), 
      lty = 1, col = 'orange', lwd = 2)
lines(variogramLine(variogram_gaussian, 1.075 * max(variogram$dist)), 
      lty = 1, col = 'green', lwd = 2)
legend(x = "bottomright", legend = c("Exponential","Spherical","Gaussian"), 
       col = c("purple","orange","green"), 
       lty = c(1,1,1),
       lwd = c(2,2,2))
```

```{r, echo =FALSE, fig.cap = "Anisotropic sample variograms"}
# Anisotropic variogram models
variogram_anis = variogram(value_avg~1, soil_ontario, alpha = c(0,45,90,135))

variogram_anis |> ggplot(aes(x= dist, y=gamma))+
  geom_point()+
  facet_grid(.~dir.hor)

```


```{r}
# block kriging to identify ideal pH
block_krige <- krige(value_avg~1, soil_ontario,
                     ontario_district, variogram_gaussian, block = c(10000, 10000))
```

```{r}
#block kriging for counties with ideal pH suitable for agriculture
block_krige$suitable <- ifelse(block_krige$var1.pred >= 6.0 &
                        block_krige$var1.pred <= 7.5,
                        "Suitable", "Not Suitable")

```



```{r, echo = FALSE, fig.cap = "Comparing block-kriged averages (left-blues) to block-kriged averages (right-greens). Note that the green block-kriged values tend to define suitability better."}



# Plot 1: pH Range
gg1 <- ggplot(block_krige) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = var1.pred), color = "white") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "pH Range") +  # or use scale_fill_distiller()
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right") +
  ggtitle("Block-Kriged pH Range")

# Plot 2: Suitability
gg2 <- ggplot(block_krige) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = suitable), color = "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("lightgreen", "darkgreen"),
    name = "pH Suitability"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right") +
  ggtitle("Districts with Suitable Soil pH")

# Arrange side-by-side
gg1 + gg2  # using patchwork


```

## Weather Data

Looking at trends in the weather.  Initial Kriging for the weather data

```{r, echo=false}
weather <- weather %>%
  mutate(
    x = st_coordinates(.)[, 1],
    y = st_coordinates(.)[, 2]
  )

#weather during corn growing season
#may-october
corn_trend <- weather %>%
  filter(month >= 5 & month <= 10) %>%
  group_by(year, month) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_temp = mean(mean_temp, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_precip = mean(total_precip, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_max_humidity = mean(max_humidity, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Plot 1: Avg Temperature
p1 <- ggplot(corn_trend, aes(x = year, y = avg_temp)) +
  geom_line(color = "firebrick", size = 1) +
  labs(title = "Avg Temp (Corn Growing Season)", y = "°C", x = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()

# Plot 2: Total Precipitation
p2 <- ggplot(corn_trend, aes(x = year, y = total_precip)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", size = 1) +
  labs(title = "Total Precipitation (Corn Season)", y = "cm", x = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()

# Plot 3: Max Humidity
p3 <- ggplot(corn_trend, aes(x = year, y = avg_max_humidity)) +
  geom_line(color = "forestgreen", size = 1) +
  labs(title = "Avg Max Humidity (Corn Season)", y = "%", x = "Year") +
  theme_minimal()

(p1 | p3) / p2

```

ontario_cd_sf <- get_census(
  dataset = "CA21",  # 2021 Census

  level = "CD",  # Census Division
  geo_format = "sf",  # Return as sf object
  labels = "short"

```
Getting the average slope for the areas

```{r}
krige_variable <- function(var_name, new_col_name, grid_sp) {
  # 1. Prep soil points
  soil_var <- soil_clean %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[var_name]])) %>%
    st_transform(st_crs(corn_data_sf)) %>%
    st_centroid(of_largest_polygon = TRUE)

  soil_sp <- as(soil_var, "Spatial")

  # 2. Variogram + model
  v <- variogram(as.formula(paste0(var_name, " ~ 1")), data = soil_sp)
  model <- fit.variogram(v, model = vgm(1, "Exp", 100000, 0.1))

  # 3. Kriging
  kriged <- krige(
    as.formula(paste0(var_name, " ~ 1")),
    soil_sp,
    newdata = grid_sp,
    model = model,
    nmax = 30
  )

  kriged_sf <- st_as_sf(kriged) %>%
    st_set_crs(st_crs(corn_data_sf))

  # 4. Spatial join to crop regions
  joined <- st_join(kriged_sf, corn_data_sf, join = st_within, left = FALSE)

  # 5. Average by region
  summary <- joined %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    group_by(county, year) %>%
    summarise(!!new_col_name := mean(var1.pred, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  return(summary)
}

```

```{r}
grid <- st_make_grid(corn_data_sf, cellsize = 5000, what = "centers") %>%
  st_sf() %>%
  st_transform(st_crs(corn_data_sf))

grid_sp <- as(grid, "Spatial")  # this is the missing part!

```


```{r}
#kirging using function
slope_summary <- krige_variable("slope1", "slope1_avg", grid_sp)
kfactor_summary <- krige_variable("k_factor1", "kfactor_avg", grid_sp)

```

```{r}
# Merge slope and kfactor summaries
corn_data_sf <- corn_data_sf %>%
  left_join(slope_summary, by = c("county", "year")) %>%
  left_join(kfactor_summary, by = c("county", "year")) %>%
  distinct(county, year, .keep_all = TRUE)  # clean duplicates

# Merge slope and kfactor summaries
soybeans_data_sf <- soybeans_data_sf %>%
  left_join(slope_summary, by = c("county", "year")) %>%
  left_join(kfactor_summary, by = c("county", "year")) %>%
  distinct(county, year, .keep_all = TRUE)  # clean duplicates

# Merge slope and kfactor summaries
wheat_data_sf <- wheat_data_sf %>%
  left_join(slope_summary, by = c("county", "year")) %>%
  left_join(kfactor_summary, by = c("county", "year")) %>%
  distinct(county, year, .keep_all = TRUE)  # clean duplicates

```

```{r}
#will figure this out later
#grouping the soil textures into more general categories
soil_clean <- soil_clean %>%
  mutate(
    texture_group = case_when(
      atexture1 %in% c("CL", "SCL", "SICL") ~ "Clay Loam",
      atexture1 %in% c("SL", "FSL", "GSL", "GL", "GLS", "VFSL", "LVFS") ~ "Sandy Loam",
      atexture1 %in% c("L", "SIL", "VAR") ~ "Loam",
      atexture1 %in% c("C", "SIC") ~ "Clay",
      atexture1 %in% c("S", "FS", "VFS", "LS", "LFS", "CSL", "LCS") ~ "Sand",
      atexture1 %in% c("ORG") ~ "Organic",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

soil_clean <- soil_clean %>%
  mutate(drainage_group = case_when(
    drainage1 %in% c("W", "WA") ~ "Well Drained",
    drainage1 %in% c("MW") ~ "Moderately Well",
    drainage1 %in% c("P", "VP") ~ "Poorly Drained",
    drainage1 %in% c("VR", "VA", "R") ~ "Very Poor",
    drainage1 %in% c("I") ~ "Imperfect",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ))

soil_cats <- soil_clean %>%
  filter(!is.na(texture_group) & !is.na(drainage_group)) %>%
  st_transform(st_crs(corn_data_sf)) %>%
  st_join(corn_data_sf, join = st_within, left = FALSE)

# Texture mode
texture_summary <- soil_cats %>%
  group_by(county, year) %>%
  summarise(texture_mode = names(sort(table(texture_group), decreasing = TRUE)[1]), .groups = "drop")

# Drainage mode
drainage_summary <- soil_cats %>%
  group_by(county, year) %>%
  summarise(drainage_mode = names(sort(table(drainage_group), decreasing = TRUE)[1]), .groups = "drop")


corn_data_sf <- corn_data_sf %>%
  left_join(texture_summary, by = c("county", "year")) %>%
  left_join(drainage_summary, by = c("county", "year")) %>%
  distinct(county, year, .keep_all = TRUE)

soybeans_data_sf <- soybeans_data_sf %>%
  left_join(texture_summary, by = c("county", "year")) %>%
  left_join(drainage_summary, by = c("county", "year")) %>%
  distinct(county, year, .keep_all = TRUE)

wheat_data_sf <- wheat_data_sf %>%
  left_join(texture_summary, by = c("county", "year")) %>%
  left_join(drainage_summary, by = c("county", "year")) %>%
  distinct(county, year, .keep_all = TRUE)

## Corn Yield

The corn growing season is from May-October.  
```{r}
#weather during the corn growing season for each year/station
weather_corn_gs <- weather %>%
  filter(month %in% 5:10)

head(weather_corn_gs)
colSums(is.na(weather_corn_gs))
```

```{r}
# Step 1: Identify rows with missing total_precip
weather_na <- weather_corn_gs %>% filter(is.na(total_precip))

# Step 2: Identify complete rows (non-NA total_precip)
weather_complete <- weather_corn_gs %>% filter(!is.na(total_precip))

# Step 3: Find nearest neighbor for each NA entry
nearest_idx <- st_nearest_feature(weather_na, weather_complete)

# Step 4: Fill NA values from nearest station's total_precip
weather_corn_gs$total_precip[is.na(weather_corn_gs$total_precip)] <- 
  weather_complete$total_precip[nearest_idx]

sum(is.na(weather_corn_gs$total_precip))

```

#### 2024 Forecast for Corn

```{r, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}

#attaching a station's information to the yield
corn_regions <- dplyr::select(corn_data_sf, county, geom)

weather_with_county <- st_join(weather_corn_gs, corn_regions, join = st_nearest_feature)


# Step 1: Fill in all county-year-month combinations (May–October)
weather_avg_complete <- weather_with_county %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(county, year, month) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_temp = mean(mean_temp, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_precip = mean(total_precip, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_humidity = mean(max_humidity, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  complete(county, year, month = 5:10)  # Ensures full seasonal structure

# Step 2: Fill in missing weather values within each county and month
weather_avg_filled <- weather_avg_complete %>%
  group_by(county, month) %>%
  fill(mean_temp, total_precip, max_humidity, .direction = "downup") %>%
  ungroup()

# Step 3: Reshape to wide format (one row per county-year)
weather_wide <- weather_avg_filled %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = month,
    values_from = c(mean_temp, total_precip, max_humidity),
    names_glue = "{.value}_m{month}"
  )

#### Autoregression 
```{r}
#creating a lag to to capture the patterns from the previous time step
full_corn_data <- full_corn_data %>%
  arrange(county, year) %>%
  group_by(county) %>%
  mutate(yield_lag1 = dplyr::lag(yield, n = 1)) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
#training and test sets for the ar
corn_train <- full_corn_data %>% filter(year < 2024)
corn_test <- full_corn_data %>% filter(year == 2024)
```

```{r}
# Identify counties with missing weather for 2024
missing_weather_2024 <- full_corn_data %>%
  filter(year == 2024 & (is.na(mean_temp_m5) | is.na(total_precip_m5))) %>%
  dplyr::select(county)

# Create sf objects for missing and available counties
missing_sf <- corn_data_sf %>%
  filter(year == 2024, county %in% missing_weather_2024$county)

available_sf <- corn_data_sf %>%
  filter(year == 2024, !county %in% missing_weather_2024$county)

# Get available weather variables
available_weather <- full_corn_data %>%
  filter(year == 2024, !county %in% missing_weather_2024$county) %>%
  dplyr::select(county, starts_with("mean_temp"), starts_with("total_precip"))

# Find nearest available county
nearest_idx <- sf::st_nearest_feature(missing_sf, available_sf)

# Get matched weather
imputed_weather <- available_weather[nearest_idx, ] %>%
  dplyr::select(starts_with("mean_temp"), starts_with("total_precip"))

# Rebuild missing counties with imputed weather
missing_filled <- full_corn_data %>%
  filter(year == 2024 & county %in% missing_weather_2024$county) %>%
  dplyr::select(-starts_with("mean_temp"), -starts_with("total_precip")) %>%
  bind_cols(imputed_weather)

# Keep only non-NA rows
full_corn_data <- full_corn_data %>%
  filter(!(year == 2024 & county %in% missing_weather_2024$county))

# Add back imputed rows
full_corn_data <- bind_rows(full_corn_data, missing_filled)
```

```{r}
corn_model_ar1_full <- lm(
  yield ~ yield_lag1 +
    mean_temp_m5 + mean_temp_m6 + mean_temp_m7 + mean_temp_m8 + mean_temp_m9 + mean_temp_m10 +
    total_precip_m5 + total_precip_m6 + total_precip_m7 + total_precip_m8 + total_precip_m9 + total_precip_m10 +
    slope1_avg + kfactor_avg,
  data = corn_train
)
```

```{r}
corn_test$yield_pred_ar1 <- predict(corn_model_ar1_full, newdata = corn_test)

corn_test %>%
  filter(is.na(full_corn_data)) %>%
  dplyr::select(county, year, yield_lag1, mean_temp_m5, total_precip_m5)
```

#### Random Walk 1

```{r}
# Random Walk 1: Predict 2024 yield as the 2023 yield (lag1)
full_corn_data <- full_corn_data %>%
  arrange(county, year) %>%
  group_by(county) %>%
  mutate(yield_rw1 = lag(yield, n = 1)) %>%
  ungroup()

corn_rw1_2024 <- full_corn_data %>%
  filter(year == 2024, !is.na(yield_rw1)) %>%
  mutate(yield_pred_rw1 = yield_rw1)
```

#### Random Walk 2
```{r}
full_corn_data <- full_corn_data %>%
  arrange(county, year) %>%
  group_by(county) %>%
  mutate(yield_rw2 = 2 * lag(yield, 1) - lag(yield, 2)) %>%
  ungroup()


corn_rw2_2024 <- full_corn_data %>%
  filter(year == 2024, !is.na(yield_rw2)) %>%
  mutate(yield_pred_rw2 = yield_rw2)
```

#### Model Evaluations

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(Metrics)

# Combine actuals and predictions
corn_2024_predictions <- corn_data_sf %>%
  filter(year == 2024) %>%
  dplyr::select(County = county, Actual_Yield_2024 = yield_bushels_ac) %>%
  mutate(Actual_Yield_2024 = as.numeric(Actual_Yield_2024)) %>%
  left_join(dplyr::select(corn_test, County = county, Pred_AR1 = yield_pred_ar1), by = "County") %>%
  left_join(dplyr::select(corn_rw1_2024, County = county, Pred_RW1 = yield_pred_rw1), by = "County") %>%
  left_join(dplyr::select(corn_rw2_2024, County = county, Pred_RW2 = yield_pred_rw2), by = "County") %>%
  mutate(
    Resid_AR1 = Pred_AR1 - Actual_Yield_2024,
    Resid_RW1 = Pred_RW1 - Actual_Yield_2024,
    Resid_RW2 = Pred_RW2 - Actual_Yield_2024
  )

# Compute overall RMSE for each model
rmse_ar1 <- rmse(corn_2024_predictions$Actual_Yield_2024, corn_2024_predictions$Pred_AR1)
rmse_rw1 <- rmse(corn_2024_predictions$Actual_Yield_2024, corn_2024_predictions$Pred_RW1)
rmse_rw2 <- rmse(corn_2024_predictions$Actual_Yield_2024, corn_2024_predictions$Pred_RW2)

# Create final RMSE row
rmse_row <- tibble(
  County = "Overall RMSE",
  Actual_Yield_2024 = NA,
  Pred_AR1 = NA,
  Pred_RW1 = NA,
  Pred_RW2 = NA,
  Resid_AR1 = rmse_ar1,
  Resid_RW1 = rmse_rw1,
  Resid_RW2 = rmse_rw2
)

# Bind to table
final_table <- bind_rows(corn_2024_predictions, rmse_row)

# View
print(final_table)


```

total_comparison <- corn_2024_predictions %>%

    Total_Pred_RW1 = sum(Pred_RW1, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_Pred_RW2 = sum(Pred_RW2, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%

    Error_AR1 = abs(Total_Pred_AR1 - Total_Actual),

  )

#### 2025 Forecast

The autoregression performed the best, so using that.

Making a data set for 2025
```{r}
# Get historical averages for Aug–Oct by county
hist_avg_late <- weather_avg %>%
  filter(month %in% 8:10) %>%
  group_by(county, month) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_temp = mean(mean_temp, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_precip = mean(total_precip, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_humidity = mean(max_humidity, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Merge with 2025 actual data up to July and fill missing with averages
weather_2025_filled <- weather_avg %>%
  filter(year == 2025) %>%
  full_join(hist_avg_late, by = c("county", "month")) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_temp = ifelse(is.na(mean_temp.x), mean_temp.y, mean_temp.x),
    total_precip = ifelse(is.na(total_precip.x), total_precip.y, total_precip.x),
    max_humidity = ifelse(is.na(max_humidity.x), max_humidity.y, max_humidity.x)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(county, month, mean_temp, total_precip, max_humidity, year = year) %>%
  replace_na(list(year = 2025))

weather_2025_wide <- weather_2025_filled %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = month,
    values_from = c(mean_temp, total_precip, max_humidity),
    names_glue = "{.value}_m{month}"
  )

```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

corn_feats <- full_corn_data %>%
  # Calculate growing season averages/sums (May–Sept for soybeans)
  dplyr::mutate(
    temp_gs   = rowMeans(dplyr::select(., mean_temp_m5:mean_temp_m10), na.rm = TRUE),
    precip_gs = rowSums(dplyr::select(., total_precip_m5:total_precip_m10), na.rm = TRUE),
    humid_gs  = rowMeans(dplyr::select(., max_humidity_m5:max_humidity_m10), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  # Standardize numeric predictors
  dplyr::mutate(
    slope1_z  = as.numeric(scale(slope1_avg)),
    kfactor_z = as.numeric(scale(kfactor_avg)),
    temp_z    = as.numeric(scale(temp_gs)),
    precip_z  = as.numeric(scale(precip_gs)),
    humid_z   = as.numeric(scale(humid_gs)),
    # Convert categorical soil vars to factors
    texture_f  = factor(texture_mode),
    drainage_f = factor(drainage_mode),
    # Make an integer ID for spatial random effect
    id = as.integer(factor(county))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(county, year, yield,
         slope1_z, kfactor_z, temp_z, precip_z, humid_z,
         texture_f, drainage_f, id)


```

```{r}

#train/test
#training on everything 2024 and before
train_data <- corn_feats %>%
  filter(year <= 2024) %>%
  mutate(y = as.numeric(yield)) %>%
  dplyr::select(county, year, y,

#running rw1 from before
f_rw1 <- y ~ 1 +

)

# Get predictions for the test rows

```{r}

```{r}

```

```{r}
# Identify counties with missing weather for 2024
missing_weather_2024 <- full_soybeans_data %>%
  filter(year == 2024 & (is.na(mean_temp_m5) | is.na(total_precip_m5))) %>%
  dplyr::select(county)

# Create sf objects for missing and available counties
missing_sf <- soybeans_data_sf %>%
  filter(year == 2024, county %in% missing_weather_2024$county)

available_sf <- soybeans_data_sf %>%
  filter(year == 2024, !county %in% missing_weather_2024$county)

# Get available weather variables
available_weather <- full_soybeans_data %>%
  filter(year == 2024, !county %in% missing_weather_2024$county) %>%
  dplyr::select(county, starts_with("mean_temp"), starts_with("total_precip"))

# Find nearest available county
nearest_idx <- sf::st_nearest_feature(missing_sf, available_sf)

# Get matched weather
imputed_weather <- available_weather[nearest_idx, ] %>%
  dplyr::select(starts_with("mean_temp"), starts_with("total_precip"))

# Rebuild missing counties with imputed weather
missing_filled <- full_soybeans_data %>%
  filter(year == 2024 & county %in% missing_weather_2024$county) %>%
  dplyr::select(-starts_with("mean_temp"), -starts_with("total_precip")) %>%
  bind_cols(imputed_weather)

# Keep only non-NA rows
full_soybeans_data <- full_soybeans_data %>%
  filter(!(year == 2024 & county %in% missing_weather_2024$county))

# Add back imputed rows
full_soybeans_data <- bind_rows(full_soybeans_data, missing_filled)
```

#### Model Evaluations

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(Metrics)

# Combine actuals and predictions
soybeans_2024_predictions <- soybeans_data_sf %>%
  filter(year == 2024) %>%
  dplyr::select(County = county, Actual_Yield_2024 = yield_bushels_acre) %>%
  mutate(Actual_Yield_2024 = as.numeric(Actual_Yield_2024)) %>%
  left_join(dplyr::select(soybeans_test, County = county, Pred_AR1 = yield_pred_ar1), by = "County") %>%
  left_join(dplyr::select(soybeans_rw1_2024, County = county, Pred_RW1 = yield_pred_rw1), by = "County") %>%
  left_join(dplyr::select(soybeans_rw2_2024, County = county, Pred_RW2 = yield_pred_rw2), by = "County") %>%
  mutate(
    Resid_AR1 = Pred_AR1 - Actual_Yield_2024,
    Resid_RW1 = Pred_RW1 - Actual_Yield_2024,
    Resid_RW2 = Pred_RW2 - Actual_Yield_2024
  )

# Compute overall RMSE for each model
rmse_ar1 <- rmse(soybeans_2024_predictions$Actual_Yield_2024, soybeans_2024_predictions$Pred_AR1)
rmse_rw1 <- rmse(soybeans_2024_predictions$Actual_Yield_2024, soybeans_2024_predictions$Pred_RW1)
rmse_rw2 <- rmse(soybeans_2024_predictions$Actual_Yield_2024, soybeans_2024_predictions$Pred_RW2)

# Create final RMSE row
rmse_row <- tibble(
  County = "Overall RMSE",
  Actual_Yield_2024 = NA,
  Pred_AR1 = NA,
  Pred_RW1 = NA,
  Pred_RW2 = NA,
  Resid_AR1 = rmse_ar1,
  Resid_RW1 = rmse_rw1,
  Resid_RW2 = rmse_rw2
)

# Bind to table
soybeans_final_table <- bind_rows(soybeans_2024_predictions, rmse_row)

# View
print(soybeans_final_table)


```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

soybeans_feats <- full_soybeans_data %>%
  # Calculate growing season averages/sums (May–Sept for soybeans)
  dplyr::mutate(
    temp_gs   = rowMeans(dplyr::select(., mean_temp_m5:mean_temp_m9), na.rm = TRUE),
    precip_gs = rowSums(dplyr::select(., total_precip_m5:total_precip_m9), na.rm = TRUE),
    humid_gs  = rowMeans(dplyr::select(., max_humidity_m5:max_humidity_m9), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  # Standardize numeric predictors
  dplyr::mutate(
    slope1_z  = as.numeric(scale(slope1_avg)),
    kfactor_z = as.numeric(scale(kfactor_avg)),
    temp_z    = as.numeric(scale(temp_gs)),
    precip_z  = as.numeric(scale(precip_gs)),
    humid_z   = as.numeric(scale(humid_gs)),
    # Convert categorical soil vars to factors
    texture_f  = factor(texture_mode),
    drainage_f = factor(drainage_mode),
    # Make an integer ID for spatial random effect
    id = as.integer(factor(county))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(county, year, yield,
         slope1_z, kfactor_z, temp_z, precip_z, humid_z,
         texture_f, drainage_f, id)

  filter(wheat_year == 2024 & (is.na(mean_temp_m5) | is.na(total_precip_m5))) %>%
  dplyr::select(county)

# Create sf objects for missing and available counties
missing_sf <- wheat_data_sf %>%
  filter(wheat_year == 2024, county %in% missing_weather_2024$county)

available_sf <- wheat_data_sf %>%
  filter(wheat_year == 2024, !county %in% missing_weather_2024$county)

# Get available weather variables
available_weather <- full_wheat_data %>%
  filter(wheat_year == 2024, !county %in% missing_weather_2024$county) %>%
  dplyr::select(county, starts_with("mean_temp"), starts_with("total_precip"))

# Find nearest available county
nearest_idx <- sf::st_nearest_feature(missing_sf, available_sf)

# Get matched weather
imputed_weather <- available_weather[nearest_idx, ] %>%
  dplyr::select(starts_with("mean_temp"), starts_with("total_precip"))

# Rebuild missing counties with imputed weather
missing_filled <- full_wheat_data %>%
  filter(wheat_year == 2024 & county %in% missing_weather_2024$county) %>%
  dplyr::select(-starts_with("mean_temp"), -starts_with("total_precip")) %>%
  bind_cols(imputed_weather)

# Keep only non-NA rows
full_wheat_data <- full_wheat_data %>%
  filter(!(wheat_year == 2024 & county %in% missing_weather_2024$county))

# Add back imputed rows
full_wheat_data <- bind_rows(full_wheat_data, missing_filled)
```

  yield ~ yield_lag1 +
    mean_temp_m10 + mean_temp_m11 + mean_temp_m12 + mean_temp_m1 + mean_temp_m2 + mean_temp_m3 + mean_temp_m4 + mean_temp_m5 + mean_temp_m6 + mean_temp_m7 +
    total_precip_m10 + total_precip_m11 + total_precip_m12 + total_precip_m1 + total_precip_m2 + total_precip_m3 + total_precip_m4 + total_precip_m5 + total_precip_m6 + total_precip_m7 +
    slope1_avg + kfactor_avg,
  data = wheat_train
)

  mutate(yield_rw1 = lag(yield, n = 1)) %>%

#### Model Evaluations

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(Metrics)

# Combine actuals and predictions
wheat_2024_predictions <- wheat_data_sf %>%
  filter(wheat_year == 2024) %>%
  dplyr::select(County = county, Actual_Yield_2024 = yield_bushels_acre) %>%
  mutate(Actual_Yield_2024 = as.numeric(Actual_Yield_2024)) %>%
  left_join(dplyr::select(wheat_test, County = county, Pred_AR1 = yield_pred_ar1), by = "County") %>%
  left_join(dplyr::select(wheat_rw1_2024, County = county, Pred_RW1 = yield_pred_rw1), by = "County") %>%
  left_join(dplyr::select(wheat_rw2_2024, County = county, Pred_RW2 = yield_pred_rw2), by = "County") %>%
  mutate(
    Resid_AR1 = Pred_AR1 - Actual_Yield_2024,
    Resid_RW1 = Pred_RW1 - Actual_Yield_2024,
    Resid_RW2 = Pred_RW2 - Actual_Yield_2024
  )

# Compute overall RMSE for each model
rmse_ar1 <- rmse(wheat_2024_predictions$Actual_Yield_2024, wheat_2024_predictions$Pred_AR1)
rmse_rw1 <- rmse(wheat_2024_predictions$Actual_Yield_2024, wheat_2024_predictions$Pred_RW1)
rmse_rw2 <- rmse(wheat_2024_predictions$Actual_Yield_2024, wheat_2024_predictions$Pred_RW2)

# Create final RMSE row
rmse_row <- tibble(
  County = "Overall RMSE",
  Actual_Yield_2024 = NA,
  Pred_AR1 = NA,
  Pred_RW1 = NA,
  Pred_RW2 = NA,
  Resid_AR1 = rmse_ar1,
  Resid_RW1 = rmse_rw1,
  Resid_RW2 = rmse_rw2
)

# Bind to table
wheat_final_table <- bind_rows(wheat_2024_predictions, rmse_row)

# View
print(wheat_final_table)


```

```{r}
#Comparing the Models to select which predicts best

total_comparison <- wheat_2024_predictions %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Actual = sum(Actual_Yield_2024, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_Pred_AR1 = sum(Pred_AR1, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_Pred_RW1 = sum(Pred_RW1, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_Pred_RW2 = sum(Pred_RW2, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Error_AR1 = abs(Total_Pred_AR1 - Total_Actual),
    Error_RW1 = abs(Total_Pred_RW1 - Total_Actual),
    Error_RW2 = abs(Total_Pred_RW2 - Total_Actual)
  )

mean_comparison <- wheat_2024_predictions %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Actual = mean(Actual_Yield_2024, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Pred_AR1 = mean(Pred_AR1, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Pred_RW1 = mean(Pred_RW1, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Pred_RW2 = mean(Pred_RW2, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Error_AR1 = abs(Mean_Pred_AR1 - Mean_Actual),
    Error_RW1 = abs(Mean_Pred_RW1 - Mean_Actual),
    Error_RW2 = abs(Mean_Pred_RW2 - Mean_Actual)
  )

```{r}


# Shift Oct-Dec into next year's record
wheat_feats <- full_wheat_data %>%
  # For convenience, create a wheat_year variable
  #mutate(wheat_year = ifelse(month >= 10, year + 1, year)) %>%
  group_by(county, wheat_year) %>%
  summarise(
    # Average temps over Oct–Jul
    temp_gs = mean(c(
      mean_temp_m10, mean_temp_m11, mean_temp_m12,  # Oct–Dec prev year
      mean_temp_m1, mean_temp_m2, mean_temp_m3, 
      mean_temp_m4, mean_temp_m5, mean_temp_m6, mean_temp_m7
    ), na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Total precip over Oct–Jul
    precip_gs = sum(c(
      total_precip_m10, total_precip_m11, total_precip_m12,
      total_precip_m1, total_precip_m2, total_precip_m3,
      total_precip_m4, total_precip_m5, total_precip_m6, total_precip_m7
    ), na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Mean humidity over Oct–Jul (if available)
    humid_gs = mean(c(
      max_humidity_m10, max_humidity_m11, max_humidity_m12,
      max_humidity_m1, max_humidity_m2, max_humidity_m3,
      max_humidity_m4, max_humidity_m5, max_humidity_m6, max_humidity_m7
    ), na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Soil variables (assumed constant over year)
    slope1_avg = first(slope1_avg),
    kfactor_avg = first(kfactor_avg),
    texture = first(texture_mode),
    drainage = first(drainage_mode),
    
    yield = first(yield),  # yield for that wheat_year
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # Standardize predictors
  dplyr::mutate(
    slope1_z  = as.numeric(scale(slope1_avg)),
    kfactor_z = as.numeric(scale(kfactor_avg)),
    temp_z    = as.numeric(scale(temp_gs)),
    precip_z  = as.numeric(scale(precip_gs)),
    humid_z   = as.numeric(scale(humid_gs)),
    texture_f  = factor(texture),
    drainage_f = factor(drainage),
    id = as.integer(factor(county))
  ) %>%
  #rename(year = wheat_year) %>%
  dplyr::select(county, wheat_year, yield,
         slope1_z, kfactor_z, temp_z, precip_z, humid_z,
         texture_f, drainage_f, id)
```



```{r}
#Making a data set for 2025
#train/test
#training on everything 2024 and before
train_data <- wheat_feats %>%
  filter(wheat_year <= 2024) %>%
  mutate(y = as.numeric(yield)) %>%
  dplyr::select(county, wheat_year, y,
         slope1_z, kfactor_z, temp_z, precip_z, humid_z,
         texture_f, drainage_f, id)

#test set- 2025 data- creating blank column for 2025
test_2025 <- wheat_feats %>%
  filter(wheat_year == 2024) %>%
  mutate(
    wheat_year = 2025,
    y = NA_real_
  )
n_train <- nrow(train_data)

stack_2025 <- bind_rows(train_data, test_2025) %>%
  mutate(time_id = as.integer(factor(wheat_year, levels = sort(unique(wheat_year)))))

#running rw1 from before
f_rw1 <- y ~ 1 +
  slope1_z + kfactor_z + temp_z + precip_z + humid_z +
  texture_f + drainage_f +
  f(time_id, model = "rw1") +
  f(id, model = "iid")

fit_rw1_2025 <- INLA::inla(
  f_rw1,
  family = "gaussian",
  data = stack_2025,
  control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE),
  control.compute   = list(dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE, cpo = TRUE)
)

# Get predictions for the test rows
n_train <- nrow(train_data)
pred_2025_rw1 <- fit_rw1_2025$summary.fitted.values$mean[(n_train + 1):nrow(stack_2025)]

results_rw1_2025 <- test_2025 %>%
  mutate(pred_yield_rw1 = pred_2025_rw1) %>%
  dplyr::select(county, wheat_year, pred_yield_rw1)

results_rw1_2025
```

map_data_rw1 <- wheat_regions %>%

  labs(
    title = "Winter Wheat Yield Change in 2025 vs 2024",
    fill = "Direction of Change"
  ) +
